newsitem.title: INDIA: Nearly 50 crew rescued from sinking India ship.
newsitem.headline: Nearly 50 crew rescued from sinking India ship.

text.p: Indian Navy and coast guard officials on Thursday rescued 49 crewmen from a ship that sank off the coast of Bombay, the country's financial capital, authorities said.
"The entire crew was rescued shortly after the ship went down," a navy spokesman told Reuters. "There were no casualties."
The ship, the Vishwa Nandini, is believed to have gone down shortly after developing a crack on the outer surface of the engine room, a coast guard official said.
The general cargo vessel is owned by the state-run Shipping Corporation of India (SCI). No further details were immediately available.
